examples.explanation: A switch expression evaluates ordered patterns and produces one result value.

guides.definition: A foreach statement binds each element exposed by an enumerable or enumerator pattern.

examples.title: Iterate a sequence
examples.explanation: A foreach statement binds each element exposed by an enumerable or enumerator pattern.

guides.definition: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and iteration expressions.

examples.explanation: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and iteration expressions.

guides.definition: A while statement tests its Boolean condition before each iteration.

examples.explanation: A while statement tests its Boolean condition before each iteration.

guides.definition: A try statement transfers control to a matching catch clause when an exception escapes its body.

examples.explanation: A try statement transfers control to a matching catch clause when an exception escapes its body.

guides.definition: A local function is a named method-like declaration scoped to its containing member.

examples.title: Declare a local function
examples.code:
static int Double(int value) => value * 2;
var answer = Double(21);
examples.explanation: A local function is a named method-like declaration scoped to its containing member.

guides.definition: A lambda expression creates an anonymous function that converts to a compatible delegate or expression-tree type.

examples.title: Create a lambda
examples.code:
Func<int, int> doubleValue = value => value * 2;
var answer = doubleValue(21);
examples.explanation: A lambda expression creates an anonymous function that converts to a compatible delegate or expression-tree type.

guides.definition: Tuple syntax groups a fixed number of values and supports positional or named deconstruction.

examples.title: Create and deconstruct a tuple
examples.explanation: Tuple syntax groups a fixed number of values and supports positional or named deconstruction.

guides.definition: A property pattern applies nested patterns to accessible properties of a non-null input value.

examples.title: Match object properties
examples.code:
var item = new { Status = "ready", Count = 42 };
var isReady = item is { Status: "ready", Count: > 0 };
examples.explanation: A property pattern applies nested patterns to accessible properties of a non-null input value.

guides.definition: A collection expression uses bracket syntax and spread elements to construct a compatible collection target.

examples.title: Create a collection value
examples.explanation: A collection expression uses bracket syntax and spread elements to construct a compatible collection target.

guides.definition: The ?? operator evaluates its right operand only when the left operand is null.

examples.title: Provide a null fallback
examples.code:
string? value = null;
var result = value ?? "fallback";
examples.explanation: The ?? operator evaluates its right operand only when the left operand is null.

guides.definition: Range syntax selects an interval whose start is inclusive and end is exclusive.

examples.title: Slice with a range
examples.explanation: Range syntax selects an interval whose start is inclusive and end is exclusive.
